categories.main_business_segments: Lucky Royal Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sale of ice cream and frozen noodles. The company also had a gastronomy business which ceased operations in April 2024, and engages in beer, rental, and management services. Its ice cream segment includes various product lines such as hard-pack frozen desserts, soft serve, and cones under brands like Duroyal and Kabisuo. The frozen noodle segment offers diverse noodle types including Japanese, Chinese, Italian styles, and rice noodles, serving both B2B and B2C channels.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced food technology and high automation in ice cream production, including patented products like Crunch Pie. For frozen noodles, it uses high-tech quick-freezing equipment to preserve freshness and quality, freezing noodles at -18°C to enable quick reheating without thawing. Production processes emphasize strict quality control, hygiene, and safety standards, with sourcing of premium raw materials such as Australian wheat and dairy products from Australia and New Zealand. The company also integrates cross-industry collaborations and continuous R&D to innovate and differentiate products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Lucky Royal serves a broad customer base including over 40,000 sales locations in Taiwan for ice cream, such as convenience stores, supermarkets, hypermarkets, restaurants, and scenic areas. Its frozen noodles are favored by more than 20,000 catering customers including five-star hotels, large chain restaurants, and food service providers. The company targets both B2B and B2C markets domestically and exports to regions including the United States, Europe, Australia, Hong Kong, and the Middle East. Consumer packs are sold through retail chains, while bulk and customized products serve food service and hospitality industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's primary market is Taiwan, where it has extensive domestic sales and distribution networks. It also exports products internationally to countries including the United States, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, South Africa, Australia, Canada, Brunei, Dubai, Indonesia, and Hong Kong. The company operates multiple plants and offices in Taiwan, including locations in Taipei, Taoyuan, Zhongli, and Tainan. It plans to continue expanding its global presence by seeking international partners and exploring new markets beyond its core ice cream and noodle products.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lucky Royal operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and production of finished ice cream and frozen noodle products. It sources key raw materials such as dairy products, flour, oils, fats, and sugar from upstream suppliers, including imports from Australia, New Zealand, and Taiwan-based suppliers. The company manages warehousing, logistics, and distribution downstream to retail and food service customers. It also provides OEM and ODM services, indicating involvement in product development and customization for clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous product innovation and development of high-value-added, differentiated products aligned with consumer trends and market demands. It invests steadily in R&D, with expenditures increasing to 1.51% of operating revenue in 2024 and plans to further increase R&D spending in 2025. Strategic priorities include enhancing food safety, health-oriented products, and expanding product lines in ice cream and frozen noodles. Lucky Royal also focuses on brand promotion through TV and digital media, balanced development of B2B and B2C channels, and exploring global partnerships to broaden product offerings and market reach.
categories.revenue_model: Lucky Royal generates revenue primarily through the sale of manufactured ice cream and frozen noodle products via B2B and B2C channels. Sales occur through retail outlets such as convenience stores, supermarkets, hypermarkets, and food service providers including restaurants and hotels. The company also earns revenue from OEM and ODM contracts by producing customized products for other brands. Additional income streams include rental and management services, as well as trademark licensing agreements. Revenue is derived from product sales domestically and through exports to international markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lucky Royal positions itself as a leading brand in Taiwan's mid-to-high-end ice cream market and as the top preferred brand in the frozen noodle industry. It competes by leveraging product innovation, brand advertising, strict quality control, and extensive distribution networks. The company holds a strong market share domestically with growing export presence. Its competitive advantages include patented products, advanced production automation, and certifications such as SQF and Halal. While specific competitors are not named, the company faces industry competition and addresses it through continuous R&D, marketing, and supply chain resilience.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Lucky Royal reported consolidated revenue of approximately NTD 2.67 billion, a decrease of about 12% from 2023, but achieved a net profit after tax of NTD 377.7 million, a 7.7% increase year-over-year. The company maintains a stable financial position with total assets of NTD 3.92 billion and a low debt ratio of 19.55%. R&D expenses accounted for 1.51% of revenue in 2024, reflecting ongoing investment in innovation. The company plans capital expenditures for production expansion, particularly in frozen noodles, and expects continued growth through product development and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lucky Royal emphasizes product innovation, quality, and safety as core differentiators, offering patented and unique ice cream products and high-quality frozen noodles with superior freshness and convenience. The company invests in brand building to maintain consumer loyalty and market presence. Its products cater to evolving consumer preferences for health, taste, and convenience, supported by rigorous raw material selection and manufacturing processes. Advanced automation and economies of scale enable consistent quality and competitive pricing. The company also provides customized OEM/ODM solutions, enhancing customer value through tailored offerings.
